## RE:volution Mod v2.12.1

### Added

- Unified E-menu chrome and integrated Rune, Resources, Achievements and Mechanic Unlock interfaces.
- Authoritative seven-resource wallet synchronization and updated Crystal, Daily and Offerings collection UI.
- Individual Unique Rune awakening and rollback with versioned persistence migration and per-rune ownership semantics.
- Unified Rune Share and context-aware actions.

### Fixed

- Restored parity between ordinary and Unique Rune rank progression and 26-slot cohort eligibility.
- Enforced COMMON-only purchases and validated authoritative awakening/rollback targets.
- Corrected Legacy Crystal/Offerings progression, Daily claim replay handling and rollback guards.
- Addressed UI targeting, selected rune feedback, resource cost display and server-authoritative purchase validation.
- Fixed ordinary Rune Share tooltips to include same-player targeted power bonuses (Snake Fang / Killer Dagger), matching final E-menu values; verified +0/+1 and a control rune in Minecraft Manual QA.

### Other

- Reduced redundant resource, mechanic progress and stats synchronization during rune actions.
- Gameplay Minecraft Manual QA completed: connection, persistence, Crystal, targeted rollback, Daily, Offerings, UI/Share (including the R12 focused retest).
- Added regression coverage for migration, network packets, collection progression and purchase concurrency.
- This release includes previously completed UI-02 changes historically planned under v2.13.0; the approved stable version is v2.12.1.
- Mongo player state and Daily history must be preserved; no database/world reset or schemaVersion-only bump is part of release.
- Deferred: UI-02-E Pets Context Slots, Crystal technical-chat notifications (#310), Share-hover localization (#315).
- Stable publication and PROD deployment are independent approval gates. Validate server/client manifest compatibility before publishing.

### Download

Download `RE-volution-2.12.1.jar` from the assets attached to this GitHub Release after the release is approved and published.
